none: PAS NLM-253A74: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate, unknown emperor, possibly issue of 260-270, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Legend present but indistinct. Reverse description: Aequitas standing left with scales. Reverse inscription: A[E]QV[--]. Diameter: 18.8mm, Weight: 2.04gms, die axis: possibly 12
